questions.question: What are the repeat order and modified repeat in business market / [CO1, CO2, CO3, CO4, CO5]
questions.solution_html: • What are the repeat order and modified repeat in the business market? Repeat Order: When a buyer purchases the same product from the same supplier without any changes in specifications, price, or terms. It is also known as a straight rebuy. Modified Repeat (Modified Rebuy): When the buyer wants to change product specifications, price, delivery schedule, or supplier due to changed needs or dissatisfaction.
